title: Chapter 584 - 584 Taming; Oil Increases By 100%!
content:
Chapter 584 - 584 Taming; Oil Increases By 100%!

Chapter 584 - 584 Taming; Oil Increases by 100%!

584 Taming; Oil Increases by 100%!

Not long after, the entire bird was eaten clean by the Heavenly Hound.

Its tail started wagging again.

Lin Fan felt the cold breeze on his face. He randomly chose a direction and walked forward.

As for the Heavenly Hound, it lowered its head and maintained a certain distance from Lin Fan, slowly following behind.

Under the sun’s rays, the shadows were gradually elongated. They matched well with the surrounding grass and the forest, making the scene very warm.

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Ten Thousand Miles of Sad Autumn: [Fortunately, the Heavenly Hound didn’t attack God Lin yesterday.]

Family Member: [It was such delicious bird meat, but it was eaten by the Heavenly Hound. God Lin is really too kind.]

Child King: [The Heavenly Hound seems to be following God Lin.]

Choice: [The scene of them walking in the wilderness is so beautiful! I want to save it.]

Dazed: [I’ll save it too.]

Hello Everyone: [Save +1.]

…

When Lin Fan passed through a patch of grass, a crisp notification sounded out in his mind.

[Ding! You’ve been in the Otherworld for 96 hours. You’ve received a special red packet and 300 Constitution points.]

The surging energy rippled back and forth within Lin Fan’s body, causing his muscles to squirm.

An even more powerful aura spread out in all directions.

Lin Fan’s lips curled up.

His footsteps involuntarily became faster and lighter.

As for the Heavenly Hound that was following behind him, it paused for a moment.

A look of surprise appeared on its face.

The Heavenly Hound looked at Lin Fan’s disappearing figure and hesitated for a while before continuing to follow.

He could only blame the food that Lin Fan gave him for being too delicious.

…

When the sky turned yellow, Lin Fan stopped.

Today, he passed through the grass and woods, but he did not find anything. He just took it as a stroll.

Lin Fan muttered, “There aren’t any big birds or rabbits nearby. Let’s see what I should eat later.”

The Heavenly Hound behind him heard this and quickly turned around.

When it returned, it had two big rabbits in its mouth that looked like the ones from yesterday.

Then, he placed them in front of Lin Fan.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan could not help but smile. “Mmm, this saves me the trouble of finding ingredients.”

After saying that, he picked up the knife and waved it quickly at the rabbits.

After a while, the two rabbits were completely skinned.

Then, Lin Fan found some dead wood and picked up the rabbit meat.

After applying the seasonings and sauce, a rich fragrance slowly drifted.

The Heavenly Hound stared at the rabbit without blinking.

When it smelled the fragrance, it saliva flowed down.

When the rabbit meat was completely roasted, Lin Fan tore off half of the meat and said, “Come, try it!”

As he spoke, he threw the rabbit meat at the Heavenly Hound.

The Heavenly Hound ate heartily, its tail wagging.

Looking at it eating, Lin Fan’s appetite seemed to increase.

As such, Lin Fan ate significantly more this time.

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Choice: [The Heavenly Hound is not bad. It could even bring back two rabbits.]

Night Rain Sent North: [It would be great if it brought back food every day. In that case, God Lin wouldn’t have to worry about food.]

Stone: [What are you worried about? God Lin wouldn’t ever have to worry about food, right? However, with the Heavenly Hound to prepare food, it could reduce some trouble.]

My Lord Is Angry: [Not bad, Heavenly Hound.]

Blaming Oneself: [Do you think God Lin is going to tame the Heavenly Hound?]

Concentration: [How is this taming? The Heavenly Hound got a taste of the roasted meat and simply refused to leave.]

Zhao Dahai: [The dog is a foodie, hahaha.]

…

After Lin Fan ate his fill, he went into his sleeping bag and slept soundly.

The Heavenly Hound looked at Lin Fan and laid down again.

However, the distance between the Heavenly Hound and Lin Fan was clearly closer than yesterday.

In the blink of an eye, another day passed.

…

Today, Lin Fan and the Heavenly Hound once again journeyed together.

A moment later, a green bamboo forest appeared in front of Lin Fan.

The air was filled with a fresh and sweet smell.

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Supreme Goodness: [There are so many bamboos here.]

Are You Happy: [If giant pandas were here, they would definitely be very happy.]

Mr. Zhao: [Giant pandas? huh? Do you think there are pandas there?]

Sad Man: [It’s really hard to say.]

Scrambled Tomato Eggs: [Come out! Giant pandas!]

Meeting: [Come out, pandas!]

…

Perhaps the audience’s call had an effect.

A large patch of bamboo forest suddenly shook.

Many of the audience members focused their attention on the scene.

They were looking forward to the appearance of giant pandas.

However, the result disappointed them.

In the next moment…

An enormous emerald green snake suddenly darted out of the bamboo forest.

The air seemed to gradually turn cold when it appeared.

The green snake seemed to think that Lin Fan was delicious. Without any hesitation, it opened its mouth and bit at him.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan raised his eyelids and pulled out his sword.

[Skill: One of the swords, sword slash!]

It was the same as when he killed the giant crocodile.

A bright light flashed.

In the next moment, the giant green snake, which had its mouth wide open and was rapidly approaching, suddenly froze.

Then, its mouth and body split into two!

In the end, the two halves of its body fell heavily to the ground, making a dull sound.

Fresh blood spurted out like a fountain, adding a different color to the quiet bamboo forest.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s ears, or rather, everyone in Hua Nation’s ears, rang with an emotionless voice.

[First to kill a level-three Bamboo Green Python. A level-three treasure chest obtained.]

[First to kill a level-three Bamboo Green Python. Hua Nation’s oil increased by 100%.]

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Brother Qiang: [F*ck!]

Oh: [F*ck!]

Brother Bao: [F*ck!]

Forever: [F*ck!]

…

The entire screen was immediately filled with all kinds of heartfelt exclamations.

After a while, something different appeared.

Single Kill: [Awesome, awesome!]

All Your Wishes Come True: [God Lin, you’re too handsome.]

Nanshan: [It doesn’t matter what kind of beast it is or how strong the enemy is. God Lin will kill them all with one sword!]

Mystic Demon: [Awesome!]

Poor Children Take Care of Their Families Early: [Moreover, Hua Nation’s oil has increased by 100%!]

Bug Fei: [God Lin has already given us controllable nuclear fusion technology. The problem of energy sources can be completely solved. It doesn’t seem to be of much use to increase oil.]

Inside and Outside the Dream: [How can oil not be useful? It can be used as an energy source, as well as a catalyst for rubber, paint, oil, and other industrial products. It’s very useful!]

Mysterious Demon: [Let me say one more thing, God Lin is awesome!]

….
